:= by
  -- The forgetful functor from RingCat to AddCommGrpCat is right adjoint
  -- because it is the composition of the forgetful functor from RingCat to AddCommGrpCat,
  -- which is known to be right adjoint.
  exact CategoryTheory.Forget₂.IsRightAdjoint.of_preserves_limits_and_filtered_colimits
    (RingCat.forget₂AddCommGroup_preservesLimits)
    (RingCat.FilteredColimits.instPreservesFilteredColimitsAddCommGrpCatForget₂RingHomCarrierAddMonoidHomCarrier)
